snippet.title: Fenix 3D Platformer - Tech Demo #2 - With Commentary
snippet.description:
Hey everyone!  Welcome to my open world 3D platformer called Fenix.  Today, I am pleased to announce that my game will officially be coming to Steam by Q4 2026!  So, let me know what you think of Tech Demo #2!  Also, you can now find & wishlist Fenix on my published Steam page store!

Since the first tech demo, the project has continued to grow significantly with many new gameplay systems, environmental features, enemies, UI improvements, animated objects, and combat improvements.  The codebase has expanded from around 15 scripts and 1000+ lines of C# code to over 30 scripts and more than 3000+ lines of code, reflecting the continued development of my project.

Below is a list of major improvements & features added to Tech Demo #2 ↓

April 2025 - March 2026
v0.0080 - v0.0162

1) Added 10+ new animated tree types including palm, fruit, and pine trees
2) Implemented all new animated ocean water and moving sky clouds
3) Added animated grass for improved environmental immersion
4) Introduced 10+ uniquely animated NPC interactions
5) Added two new discoverable NPC dialogue conversations
6) Implemented the Lost Slimes quest, now fully operational
7) Added floating platforms to expand traversal mechanics
8) Introduced three enemy types including the spider, bee, and mushroom
9) Implemented enemy waypoint movement patterns with player detection
10) Added enemy attack animations, death animations, and sound effects
11) Improved overall combat mechanics with all new fox animations
12) Added fox claw attack and tail attack abilities with sound effects
13) Implemented fox roll mechanic for faster movement
14) Added jump sound effect for player movement feedback
15) Implemented free-look camera functionality for improved view control
16) Added health pickups and death screen when health reaches zero
17) Enabled loading save data from the title screen and pause menu
18) Added UI button hovering colour effects and button click sound effects
20) Added an all new music playlist with music from Arno Cyreus
21) Added landmarks including a lighthouse, a temple, and a hot air balloon
22) Expanded the map with many new objects & map layout improvements
24) Addressed numerous legacy bugs and gameplay issues
25) Added splash screen effects & a game version included on titlescreen

Lastly, subscribing to the channel or leaving a comment about what you enjoyed the most would mean a lot to me, and it will also help you stay up to date on future development progress and upcoming release dates.  Thank you for checking out the showcase!

Photosensitive Warning: Read Before Playing!
Certain conditions may induce previously undetected epileptic symptoms even in persons who have no history of prior seizures or epilepsy. If you, or anyone in your family, have an epileptic condition, consult your physician prior to playing.
